Photo 1 shows the front view of the same bike, with a headlight unit, mirrors, and a front fender. The brand name 'SQUAW' is visible on the front panel. The bike has a single front wheel and a rear wheel with a kickstand. The tires are worn, and the frame shows signs of use and dirt.
The bike has a black seat, a rear storage box, and a white and black rear rack. The front suspension appears to be a fork, and the rear suspension is not clearly visible.
No visible damage to the frame or wheels, but the tires show significant wear and dirt. The battery pack is rectangular and mounted on the frame, with blue indicator lights visible.
The bike is not in a showroom or garage; it is outdoors on a paved surface, suggesting it is being sold as-is.
